name: Talordata SERP API
description: Real-time SERP API for structured search results from Google, Bing, Yandex, DuckDuckGo, and other major search engines.
notes: Talordata offers a free trial for its SERP API, but it does not currently provide a permanent free public plan. The API is designed for developers, SEO teams, AI agents, and data teams that need structured real-time search engine results for rank monitoring, competitor tracking, local SEO, trend monitoring, e-commerce intelligence, and search-driven workflows.
